thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected on API Gateway (prod). Spike started ~08:12 UTC, 5xx ~12% of traffic. Auto-pager triggered.
rohan: I'm on it — pulling gateway logs and RL traces.
ashley: I see a concurrent spike of 429s emitted by rl-service around the same time. Could be quota enforcement.
jamie: Confirmed: gateway is getting 429s from rl-service; gateway retries are filling downstream worker pools and producing 502/504s. Top affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat.
rohan: Any recent deploys to rl-service or quota config changes? ops-lead, you were on the morning deploy.
ops-lead: We rolled rl-service v2.1.3 at 07:50 UTC — that rollout included a global quota enforcement flag.
sre-rotation: Rolling back rl-service to v2.1.2 as an initial mitigation. ETA ~3m.
incident-bot: deploy-bot: rollback initiated for rl-service -> v2.1.2 (deploy-id: deploy-rl-2026-349).
ashley: Also pushing a temp config change to disable strict global enforcement while we stabilize. Patch command: 
```
curl -X PATCH https://cfg.internal/api -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \\
  -d '{"enforce_global_quota":false,"quota_mode":"warn"}'
```
rohan: Patch applied, received 200. Monitoring metrics.
jamie: Gateway 5xx down from 12% -> ~4% in last 90s but still seeing 429 fanout from rl-service causing queue stalls.
ops-lead: To avoid thundering herd, disabling automatic retries on 429 at the gateway: set retry-on-429=false.
sre-rotation: Patch applied to gateway via kubectl: 
```
kubectl -n gateway set env deployment/gateway RETRY_ON_429=false
```
incident-bot: Note: customer-impact flagged — top affected tenants: t-9876, t-2233, t-1100. CS brief posted.
ashley: Initial customer comms posted to #customer-success: "Investigating intermittent errors affecting a subset of requests. Mitigation in progress; updates to follow."
rohan: Observability shows KV-cache pressure + request queue depth peaked. Initiating traffic reroute to fallback pool in us-west-2 for heavy routes.
jamie: Adding routing rule to divert failing routes to fallback pool: 
```
/api/routing -> rule: if route in [v1.generate] && error_rate>5% then route->fallback-pool
```
ops-lead: Reroute active. Early signals: latency for critical tenants back to normal. Error rate now ~1.1%.
sre-rotation: Seeing a small number of residual 502s from model-proxy — looks like TCP/timeouts due to backlog.
ashley: Temporarily increase model-proxy RPC timeout 10s -> 30s to let in-flight requests finish. Not a long-term fix.
rohan: Timeout updated. Also throttling burst QPS for tenant t-9876 to 75% to stabilize backend pressure.
incident-bot: pagerduty-bot: paging next-oncall for handoff: @sre-night (jamie) — please acknowledge for extended mitigation and postmortem.
jamie: Acknowledged. I'll own the postmortem. Current actions: verify rollback, add RL config validation test, add gateway->rl circuit-breaker.
ops-lead: Filing follow-up RFC RFC-2026 with owners, will track permanent fixes and test coverage.
ashley: Draft root-cause: a bug in the new global quota enforcement path collapsed per-tenant scopes to a global key on some request paths, causing over-eager 429s. Gateway retry semantics amplified the effect into downstream 5xx/backpressure.
jamie: Customer impact estimate: 4 high-throughput customers experienced degraded requests for roughly 7-14 minutes during spike window. No evidence of data loss. CS will send targeted follow-ups.
sre-rotation: Marking incident as mitigated — 5xx returned to baseline. Continuing to monitor for 30m. If stable, we'll close and write the postmortem.
incident-bot: Incident status updated: MITIGATED -> monitoring. Start ts 4923456789, mitigation recorded at 4923456827.
rohan: Handoff notes to night oncall: check rl_errors_5xx, rl_429_rate, gateway retry counters, fallback-pool health, and confirm rollback remains stable. Ensure the new config validation test is blocking future rollouts until coverage added.
jamie: Thanks team — I'll compile timeline + RCA and link RFC. :heart: Closing thread once monitoring window completes.
